name: Training the Beast
summary: A fellow hunter sends you to Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar to learn how to train your pet. Her teaching gives you more ways to care for and guide it.

sections.title: Quel'dora's Teaching
sections.body: Your fellow hunter points you to his sister, Quel'dora Quickgale, in Valanaar. You can already tame a pet, but learning to train it is the next part of guiding it. Quel'dora can teach you to train your companion.

sections.title: A Hunter's Charge
sections.body: Quel'dora can teach you to guide your pet, teach it new abilities, feed it, and revive it if it falls in battle. She urges you to respect the balance and remain in awe of the nature around you.

faq.answer: Quel'dora Quickgale is the sister of the hunter who sends you to learn pet training.
Quel'dora teaches you to train and guide your pet, including teaching it abilities, feeding it, and reviving it if it falls in battle.

faq.q: Can I already tame a pet?
faq.answer: The hunter who sends you to Quel'dora says you already have the power to tame a pet.

faq.q: What does the hunter ask me to do?
faq.answer: The hunter asks you to speak with Quel'dora Quickgale in Valanaar.

faq.q: What does Quel'dora say about nature?
faq.answer: Quel'dora urges you to respect the balance and live in awe of the nature around you.

angles.text: As a hunter, you are learning to train and guide a pet you can already tame.

attribution: In-game quest text: Training the Beast
